summary: get_url options for SSL client certs and keys, gzip decompression, dest behavior (directory vs file), force re-downloading, and forcing basic auth.
questions: How do I use a client certificate with get_url?
Why doesn't get_url re-download a file that already exists?
What happens when dest is a directory?
Why does basic auth fail with get_url and how do I fix it?

answer_card.title: get_url dest, force and client certs
answer_card.answer_md:
- `dest` (required): absolute path. If a directory, uses server filename or URL basename, always downloads, replaces only if changed (`force` no effect).
- `force` (false): if false, only downloads when dest is missing; true re-downloads every time
- `force_basic_auth` (false): send auth upfront for servers that don't return 401
- `client_cert` / `client_key`: PEM files for mTLS
- `decompress` (true): gunzip gzip-encoded responses
